text: dsh-mercury-diffusion 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的 Inception Mercury 扩散播放插件。它不注册新的模型提供商，而是在已配置的兼容路由支持扩散请求时，为对话请求补入 diffusing 标记，并将逐步去噪帧通过独立 SSE 通道送到浏览器，在助手回答气泡中按节奏播放。插件会按提供商和模型探测能力，给出每模型开关；不支持的模型、含图像或文件的请求及未观看的会话继续使用原适配器。最终文本才进入正常会话记录。适合使用 Mercury 并希望在 DSH 网页中查看真实生成过程的用户；需要配置带凭据的模型路由。

dsh-mercury-diffusion plays Mercury denoising frames in DSH Web chat. It probes the configured route, reissues eligible watched text requests with diffusion enabled, and streams frames to the answer bubble. Other requests use the original adapter; only final text enters the session log.
我想在 DSH 网页聊天里看到 Mercury 的文字逐步生成过程。
有没有办法把 Mercury 的真实去噪帧显示在回答气泡里？
让 DSH 对支持扩散的模型播放生成中的中间文本。
我希望每个模型可以单独开启或关闭扩散动画。
DSH 网页能不能探测当前模型是否支持 Mercury diffusion？
想在聊天回答完成前看见去噪文本如何收敛。
Show Mercury's real denoising frames as an answer is generated in DSH Web.
Can I toggle diffusion playback separately for each model route?
dsh-mercury-diffusion 的功能「能力探测」：打开对话时按提供商和模型检测上游是否识别 diffusing 字段，并缓存结果；只在探测确认支持时展示扩散开关。
dsh-mercury-diffusion 的功能「路由桥接」：对已启用且正在观看的文本请求补发 Mercury 扩散请求；不适用时交还原适配器处理。
dsh-mercury-diffusion 的功能「逐帧播放」：中间去噪文本通过独立帧通道发送到浏览器，并在助手回答气泡中按节奏渐进显示。
dsh-mercury-diffusion 的功能「每模型开关」：会话停靠区提供扩散状态控件，按提供商和模型保存用户选择。
dsh-mercury-diffusion 的功能「最终回答落盘」：扩散帧只用于展示；流结束后将收敛后的完整回答作为文本增量交给 DSH，保持会话记录为最终答案。

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · dsh-mercury-diffusion：**Watch a diffusion LLM think — live, inside your DeepSeek Harness chat.**

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) plugin that streams the real denoising frames of [Inception Mercury](https://docs.inceptionlabs.ai) and plays them in the answer bubble, from noise to finished text.

[](LICENSE)
[](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · Highlights：- **Real frames, not a fake animation.** Every frame is a denoising state returned by the Mercury API (`diffusing: true`), replayed at a readable pace.
- **Works with the provider route you already have.** The plugin registers no provider and no settings page of its own; it adds a diffusion layer under the route you add on dsh's Models page.
- **Zero-cost capability probe.** Whether a route/model honors `diffusing` is measured with a request that is rejected before any token is generated. No model-name guessing, no billed tokens.
- **Never breaks a conversation.** Attachments, auxiliary calls, unwatched sessions, routes without a credential, or a gateway that rejects the field all fall back to the original adapter untouched.
- **Clean session logs.** Intermediate frames travel on a side channel; only the converged text is written to the log and shown to the model.
- **One-click toggle per model.** A small floating button appears for capable models; your choice is stored in dsh user settings (plugin config key `diffusion.<provider>::<model>`) and survives restarts.

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · Quick start：**Requirements:** dsh `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`, Node `^22.19 || >=24`, and [`pnpm`](https://pnpm.io) on your `PATH` (`dsh plugin` uses it to manage profile plugins).

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · 1. Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mercury-diffusion
dsh web
```

<details>
<summary>Install from source instead</summary>

```sh
git clone https://github.com/TonyWu2333/dsh-mercury-diffusion.git
cd dsh-mercury-diffusion
npm install

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · 2. Add an Inception route：Open **Settings → Models → Add model provider → Custom model API** and fill in:

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider ID | `inception` |
| Display name | `Inception` |
| Base URL | `https://api.inceptionlabs.ai/v1` (must include `/v1`) |
| API protocol | OpenAI Chat Completions |
| API key | your Inception API key |
| Models | **Add model** → `mercury-3` (or `mercury-2.5`, `mercury-2`) |

Then click **Create provider**.

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · 2. Add an Inception route：> [!WARNING] > Don't point the built-in **DeepSeek** card at Inception. That adapter speaks a different protocol, and requests fail with `404`.
Prefer config files? Add the route to cordis.patch.yml ```yaml

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：- id: llm-pi-ai
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"
  config:
    providers:
      inception:
        displayName: Inception
        api: openai-completions
        baseURL: https://api.inceptionlabs.ai/v1
        apiKeyEnv: INCEPTION_API_KEY   # a credential reference, not the key itself
        models:
          - id: mercury-3
            name: Mercury 3
            contextWindow: 1000000
            maxTokens: 131072
```

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：Use the bare model id (`mercury-3`) when calling Inception directly. Gateways that aggregate providers usually expect the prefixed form (`inception/mercury-3`).

</details>

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · 3. Turn it on：Pick the Mercury model from the model selector next to the send button and start a new conversation. A floating button appears on the right edge; switch diffusion **on** and send a message.

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · How it works：```mermaid flowchart LR A["dsh llm/stream"] -->|"capable model, toggle on, session watched"| B["Bridge
re-sends with diffusing: true"] A -->|"anything else"| Z["Original adapter"] B --> C["Mercury SSE
full text per frame"]
Design notes

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · How it works：- **Frames never enter the session log or the model's context.** dsh's `StreamChunk` protocol only appends `text-delta`, while a diffusion frame replaces the whole text. Frames therefore travel on a side channel, and only the converged text is persisted as a normal assistant message, which keeps dsh's "model-visible ⟺ logged" invariant.
- **`diffusing` is requested only while a browser is watching.** The floating button component also holds the frame subscription, which is the "someone is watching" signal. Title generation, compaction, and headless/ACP runs always use plain incremental streaming.
- **Capability is probed, not inferred.** On entering a conversation, the plugin sends `messages: []` with `diffusing` set to an invalid type. Validation rejects it with `400` before generation; only a server that knows the field also reports a type error at `loc: ["body","diffusing"]`. The verdict (`yes` / `no` / `unknown`) is cached per `provider::model` in the process; `unknown` is kept for 60 seconds only.
- **Only faithful re-sends are bridged.** Images or files, auxiliary calls, unwatched sessions, and disabled models go to the original ada

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · How it works：
About the replaced assistant renderer dsh exposes no extension point for the body of assistant messages, and keyed slots can only be replaced, not wrapped. The plugin therefore registers `conversation.chat.node[assistant-step]` at a higher priority, so **assistant messages from every model render through it**. The normal path is ported from dsh ui-chat's `AssistantNodeView` (MIT, see [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · How it works：- **Kept as-is:** Markdown and code blocks (`MarkdownText`), file links, step folding, and the official reasoning-body and image-gallery factories.
- **Difference from native:** the "preview after completion" setting for reasoning belongs to ui-chat's own registration and isn't visible to the plugin, so the preview shows only while generating.
- **Fully reversible:** disabling or uninstalling the plugin restores dsh's native renderer immediately.
- **Upgrade risk:** if a dsh release changes the assistant message shape, this renderer must be updated with it.
dsh-mercury-diffusion README · How it works：</details>

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · Upgrading from 0.1.x：0.1.x registered its own `mercury` provider, with the API key read from `INCEPTION_API_KEY` or set on the plugin's settings page. Both are gone in 0.2: add the Inception route as shown above and point your default model at it. Conversations pinned to the old `mercury` provider need a model re-selection.

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · Upgrading from 0.1.x：A route that names no credential reference (no `apiKeyEnv` in its profile and no auth variable declared by its adapter) is never bridged, so the plugin never sends one provider's key to another provider's host. Keys entered on the Models page are stored as references automatically.

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Likely cause |
|---|---|
| `DeepSeek Messages request failed (404)` | The Inception URL was entered on the built-in DeepSeek card. Add a **Custom model API** route instead. |
| The floating button never appears | The route has no credential, or the probe returned `unknown`. Check `detail` in the status payload (see below). |
| No animation, plain streaming | Diffusion is off for this model, the turn has attachments, or no browser tab is watching the session. |

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · Troubleshooting：To log frame receipt and bubble claiming, run this in the browser console and reload:

```js
localStorage.setItem('dsh-mercury-debug', '1')
```

The last status payload is kept in `localStorage['dsh-mercury-last-status']`. Its `detail` field names the step that decided the verdict (`measured`, `no-route`, `no-credential`, or `no-selection`).

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · Known limitations：- Inception documents diffusion frames for **text** only. Whether tool-call arguments arrive as deltas or full snapshots in diffusion mode is undocumented; the bridge keeps both forms and picks the one that parses as JSON at the end. This has not been verified against the real API.
- Playback uses real frames, so the frame count is up to the model: typically 5–10 frames, about 1–2 seconds of animation. Inception's website uses a fixed 1.5-second front-end animation.
- There are no browser-side settings: dsh browser plugins can't read `cordis.yml`, so playback pacing and reconnect backoff are constants in code.
- Inception's free tier may be rate-limited at peak times ("free tier is at capacity"); dsh retries automatically and playback resumes on success.
- Mercury accepts text input only. dsh turns images into text placeholders, and turns with images or files are not bridged.
- Bridged requests don't forward `reasoningEffort` or `temperature` (see design notes).

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · Development：```sh
git clone https://github.com/TonyWu2333/dsh-mercury-diffusion.git
cd dsh-mercury-diffusion
npm install
npm run typecheck

The build enforces bundle purity: the client bundle may only `require` modules from dsh's `PLATFORM_MODULES` and must not inline any `@deepseek-ai/*` runtime code.

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · Development：`scripts/mock-mercury.mjs` is a local stand-in for the Mercury endpoint (`http://127.0.0.1:18931/v1`; tune with `MOCK_PORT`, `MOCK_STEPS`, `MOCK_STEP_MS`). It returns step-by-step denoised text for `diffusing` requests and plain deltas otherwise. To connect it, add a route on **Settings → Models → Add model provider → Custom model API**, no config file needed:

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · Development：| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Base URL | `http://127.0.0.1:18931/v1` |
| API protocol | OpenAI Chat Completions |
| Models | `mercury-3` |
| API key | anything; the mock doesn't check it |

> [!NOTE]
> Since 0.2 the plugin decides capability with a probe that the mock doesn't answer the way Inception does, so the toggle stays hidden against it. Use a real Inception key to try the full diffusion flow.

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · 亮点：- **真实帧，不是假动画。** 每一帧都是 Mercury API（`diffusing: true`）返回的去噪状态，按可读的节奏回放。
- **直接用你已有的 provider 路由。** 插件不注册任何 provider，也不提供自己的配置页，只在你于 dsh 模型设置页里添加的路由下面加一层扩散渲染。
- **零成本能力探测。** 某个路由和模型是否支持 `diffusing`，用一条在生成之前就会被拒的请求来判断。不按模型名猜，也不花 token。
- **绝不弄坏对话。** 带附件、辅助调用、没人查看的会话、没有凭证的路由、不认这个字段的网关，一律原样交还原适配器。
- **会话日志干净。** 中间帧走旁路通道，只有收敛后的文本写入日志、发给模型。
- **每个模型一键开关。** 支持扩散的模型会出现一个悬浮按钮；你的选择存进 dsh 用户设置（插件配置的 `diffusion.<provider>::<model>`），重启后保持。

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · 3. 打开扩散渲染：在发送按钮旁的模型选择器里选 Mercury 模型，开一个新对话。右侧会出现一个悬浮按钮，把扩散渲染**打开**，然后发消息即可。

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · 工作方式：```mermaid flowchart LR A["dsh llm/stream"] -->|"支持扩散、开关已开、有人在看"| B["桥接
带上 diffusing: true 重发"] A -->|"其他情况"| Z["原适配器"] B --> C["Mercury SSE
每帧都是完整文本"]
设计要点

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · 工作方式：- **中间帧不进入会话日志，也不会发给模型。** dsh 的 `StreamChunk` 协议里 `text-delta` 只能追加，而扩散帧是整段替换，所以帧走旁路通道，只有收敛后的文本作为正常 assistant 消息落盘。这遵守 dsh "模型可见 ⟺ 写入日志"的约束。
- **只有当某个浏览器正在查看该会话时才请求 `diffusing`。** 悬浮按钮组件同时保持帧通道订阅，作为"有人在看"的信号。标题生成、上下文压缩等辅助请求，以及 headless / ACP 等没有 Web 的场景，一律使用普通增量流式。
- **扩散能力由探针判定，不看模型名。** 进入会话时发一条 `messages: []`、并把 `diffusing` 传成非法类型的请求。校验发生在生成之前，所以一定在产出 token 之前被 400；只有认识这个字段的服务端才会额外报一条 `loc: ["body","diffusing"]` 类型错误。结论（`yes` / `no` / `unknown`）按 `provider::model` 缓存在进程内，`unknown` 只缓存 60 秒。
- **只接管能忠实重发的请求。** 带图片或文件、辅助调用、没有浏览器查看的会话、该模型开关关闭，一律交还原适配器；网关若在第一帧之前拒绝 `diffusing`，也会退回原适配器；用户主动中止时直接结束，不会用已中止的信号再发一次。
- **只加扩散标志，不转发采样参数。** 网关的 reasoning effort 词汇（`max` / `xhigh`）和 temperature 范围都和 Inception 不同，所以重发时丢掉 `reasoningEffort` 和 `temperature`，只加上 `diffusing: true`；`max_completion_tokens`、`stop`、tools 照常转发。
- **按节奏回放。** Mercury 一次回答通常只有 5 到 10 帧，而且往往同时到达，所以浏览器端每帧至少显示 180 毫秒，收敛后停留 400 毫秒再换成 Markdown。
- **气泡认领。** 一次扩散只绑定到一个气泡：要么是正在生成的气泡，要么是正文与最终帧完全相同的气泡。多步回合里，后一步的气泡不会抢走前一步还在播放的动画。
- **帧通道只对 owner 开放。** 鉴权沿用 dsh Connection 的规则。

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · 工作方式：
关于被替换的助手消息渲染器 dsh 没有给助手消息的正文开放扩展点，而 keyed 插槽只能整体替换、不能包一层。所以插件以更高优先级注册了 `conversation.chat.node[assistant-step]`，**所有模型的助手消息都会经过它**。正常情况下的渲染移植自 dsh ui-chat 的 `AssistantNodeView`（MIT 许可，见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)）。

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · 工作方式：- **完全沿用：** Markdown 和代码块（`MarkdownText`）、文件链接、过程折叠，以及官方的思考过程正文和图片画廊 Factory。
- **与原生的差异：** 思考过程的"完成后预览"开关读的是 ui-chat 自己注册时拿到的设置，插件拿不到，所以只在生成过程中显示预览。
- **随时可恢复：** 停用或卸载插件后，dsh 原生的渲染器立刻恢复。
- **升级风险：** dsh 升级如果改了助手消息的数据结构，需要同步更新这个渲染器。

</details>

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · 从 0.1.x 升级：旧版会自己注册一个名为 `mercury` 的 provider（API Key 默认读 `INCEPTION_API_KEY`，也可以在插件设置页里填）。这两样在 0.2 都已移除：请按上面的步骤添加 Inception 路由，并把默认模型指向它。原先固定在 `mercury` provider 上的会话需要重新选一次模型。

没有凭证引用的路由（profile 里没有 `apiKeyEnv`，适配器也没声明认证用的环境变量）不会被桥接，插件不会把一家 provider 的 key 发到另一家的地址。在模型设置页里填的 API Key 会自动存成引用。

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · 排查问题：| 现象 | 可能原因 |
|---|---|
| `DeepSeek Messages request failed (404)` | Inception 地址填进了内置的 DeepSeek 卡片。改为添加一条**自定义模型API**路由。 |
| 悬浮按钮一直不出现 | 路由没有凭证，或探测结果是 `unknown`。查看状态里的 `detail`（见下）。 |
| 没有动画，只有普通流式输出 | 该模型的扩散开关是关的、这一轮带了附件，或者没有浏览器标签页在看这个会话。 |

在浏览器控制台执行下面这行后刷新页面，会输出帧接收和气泡认领日志：

```js
localStorage.setItem('dsh-mercury-debug', '1')
```

最近一次状态保存在 `localStorage['dsh-mercury-last-status']`，其中 `detail` 字段说明了结论是在哪一步得出的（`measured`、`no-route`、`no-credential` 或 `no-selection`）。

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · 已知限制：- Inception 文档只说明了扩散模式下的**文本**帧。工具调用参数在扩散模式下是增量还是整段快照，文档没有写。桥接会同时保留两种拼法，在结束时选择能解析成 JSON 的那种。这一行为还没有用真实 API 验证。
- 播放的是真实去噪帧，帧数由模型决定，一般只有 5 到 10 帧，动画约 1 到 2 秒；官网用的是固定 1.5 秒的前端动画。
- 浏览器端没有配置项：dsh 的浏览器插件读不到 `cordis.yml`，所以回放节奏和重连退避时间都是代码里的常量。
- Inception 免费额度在高峰期会限流（"free tier is at capacity"），dsh 会自动重试，重试成功后照常播放。
- Mercury 只接受文本输入：图片会由 dsh 转成文字占位，带图片或文件的回合不走桥接。
- 桥接的请求不转发 `reasoningEffort` 和 `temperature`（见设计要点）。

dsh-mercury-diffusion README · 开发：```sh
git clone https://github.com/TonyWu2333/dsh-mercury-diffusion.git
cd dsh-mercury-diffusion
npm install
npm run typecheck

构建脚本会做纯度检查：客户端 bundle 只允许 require dsh `PLATFORM_MODULES` 中的模块，并且不能内联任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` 运行时代码。

`scripts/mock-mercury.mjs` 是一个本地假的 Mercury 服务（`http://127.0.0.1:18931/v1`，可用 `MOCK_PORT`、`MOCK_STEPS`、`MOCK_STEP_MS` 调整）。`diffusing` 请求返回逐步去噪的整段文本，其他请求返回普通增量。起好后，在 **设置 → 模型 → 添加模型供应商 → 自定义模型API** 加一条路由即可，不需要改任何配置文件：

| API protocol | OpenAI Chat Completions |

| API key | 随便填，mock 不校验 |
